items.approved_script: The one I trust is Natural Rems Sea Moss. Wild Irish sea moss, apple, apple cider vinegar, ginger and dandelion, sixteen in one gummy.
Search Natural Rems Sea Moss on Amazon. Or tap my profile picture, the link is waiting in my stories, or right there in my bio.
But let's be real. Dicing, mixing and baking a whole tray every time the craving hits takes an hour.
So on busy days I reach for what the ocean has given me for fifty years, sea moss. It feeds that same gut.
